title: Dave Rossi's fourth orb in the MH370 videos

tellings.quote: Rossy's fourth orb. That's why Ashton now goes by four orbs.

plain: Videos said to show glowing orbs circling the Malaysia Airlines plane MH370 before it vanished in 2014 are said to contain a fourth orb, first spotted by a man named Dave Rossi. The Navy scientist Salvatore Pais, known for patents on unusual craft, tells Michels this, and adds that it is why Ashton Forbes, an online researcher who promotes the videos, now goes by "four orbs".
